Scene intention: Kiva reads eleven returns: eight negative, Westerley, Tarnfoot, Holloway. No fever recorded is not proof of no fever. Noa records two hairs, 12:44 Wednesday and 12:52 Thursday morning, without claiming cause. His fourth column is ash. Holloway changes Kiva’s understanding of a second’s silence: it must end in testimony. The sealed page establishes independent words, not an explanation of the sky.
